facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: near hit - electrical exposure at P-9501

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on P-9501 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. P-9501 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during shift handover while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 11 December 2008 a near hit was recorded on P-9501 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
